title: Pressurised pipe loop between two anchors: thrust, deflection and wall force
source: closed form by Castigliano's theorem at the loop's elastic centre with bending, axial and shear flexibility (Timoshenko members: J. S. Przemieniecki, Theory of Matrix Structural Analysis, McGraw-Hill 1968, §5.6), the pressure acting as the free axial strain (1 − 2ν) A/E of Lamé's solution with the closed-end force (Timoshenko and Goodier 1970, §28; C. P. Sparks, J. Energy Resources Technology 106(1):46-54, 1984)

quantities.reason: the two-node Timoshenko element is exact for end loads and a uniform initial strain; the thrust is 1.1e-3 of the pressure force pair it balances, which amplifies round-off by about 900
